title: Solid and satisfying drive feel
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe the G60 as having a solid, substantial, and satisfying driving feel, with a few fragments drifting into design, dealership, or charging-routine mentions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise solid ride quality, satisfying driving feel, quietness, comfort, cornering, and an overall substantial sense of build.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention satisfying design or a satisfying prior 5 Series reference without a clear evaluative judgment about the current vehicle topic.

limitations: Several fragments are only loosely about drive feel and include unrelated subjects such as dealership bookkeeping, learning the controls, or charging routine, so the topic is not fully coherent.
Examples are limited, so cross-country or powertrain differences cannot be meaningfully characterized from these fragments alone.
